column1: # CHAOS-13958 / CHAOS-13833: race-leg placement apart rules (ci/go_race_shard.awk apart=, the race legs, root module only). Format: kind<TAB>package<TAB>value.
# heavy<TAB>package<TAB>seconds: a race package the plan keeps apart. The plan puts at most one heavy package on a leg, and none
# on a leg that holds a listed part: two of them in one parallel batch ran 1.2-2.0x their time alone (Go quality 44091722883,
# and checkgo with helm). Seconds = the median of the package's go test "ok" seconds in its three main push runs
# (docs, authapi, helm: the first three; affected, checkgo: 44091722883, 44105231987, 44118503347, each alone on a leg), rounded up.
# part<TAB>package<TAB>part: a serial race part (ci/go_race_splits.tsv) whose leg takes no heavy package (its run alone after the
# batch adds to the heavy package's wall).
# Sorted (LC_ALL=C), no duplicates. A heavy row names a race package with a ci/go_race_weights.d row that is not split, solo or pinned.
